push_subscriptions_deactivation_complete.name: push_subscriptions_deactivation_complete
push_subscriptions_deactivation_complete.value:
("identity"."push_subscriptions"."is_active" = true AND "identity"."push_subscriptions"."deactivated_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("identity"."push_subscriptions"."is_active" = false AND "identity"."push_subscriptions"."deactivated_at" IS NOT NULL)

protocol_versions_publication_complete.name: protocol_versions_publication_complete
protocol_versions_publication_complete.value:
("research"."protocol_versions"."status" = 'DRAFT' AND "research"."protocol_versions"."version_number" IS NULL AND "research"."protocol_versions"."published_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("research"."protocol_versions"."status" <> 'DRAFT' AND "research"."protocol_versions"."version_number" IS NOT NULL AND "research"."protocol_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

protocol_steps_occurrence_index_needs_re.name: protocol_steps_occurrence_index_needs_reference
protocol_steps_occurrence_index_needs_re.value: "research"."protocol_steps"."trigger_occurrence_index" IS NULL OR "research"."protocol_steps"."trigger_step_id" IS NOT NULL

protocol_steps_rate_limits_scoped.name: protocol_steps_rate_limits_scoped
protocol_steps_rate_limits_scoped.value:
"research"."protocol_steps"."step_kind" = 'PARTICIPANT_INITIATED'
          OR ("research"."protocol_steps"."min_interval_iso" IS NULL AND "research"."protocol_steps"."max_per_day" IS NULL AND "research"."protocol_steps"."max_total" IS NULL)

consent_versions_publication_complete.name: consent_versions_publication_complete
consent_versions_publication_complete.value:
("research"."consent_versions"."status" = 'DRAFT' AND "research"."consent_versions"."version_number" IS NULL AND "research"."consent_versions"."published_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("research"."consent_versions"."status" <> 'DRAFT' AND "research"."consent_versions"."version_number" IS NOT NULL AND "research"."consent_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

participant_sessions_cancellation_comple.name: participant_sessions_cancellation_complete
participant_sessions_cancellation_comple.value: ("research"."participant_sessions"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("research"."participant_sessions"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "research"."participant_sessions"."cancellation_reason" IS NOT NULL)

participant_sessions_window_ordered.name: participant_sessions_window_ordered
participant_sessions_window_ordered.value:
"research"."participant_sessions"."available_from" IS NULL OR "research"."participant_sessions"."available_until" IS NULL
          OR "research"."participant_sessions"."available_until" > "research"."participant_sessions"."available_from"

notification_attempts_suppression_comple.name: notification_attempts_suppression_complete
notification_attempts_suppression_comple.value:
("research"."notification_attempts"."outcome" = 'SUPPRESSED' AND "research"."notification_attempts"."suppression_reason" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("research"."notification_attempts"."outcome" <> 'SUPPRESSED' AND "research"."notification_attempts"."suppression_reason" IS NULL)

notification_attempts_attempted_at_consi.name: notification_attempts_attempted_at_consistent
notification_attempts_attempted_at_consi.value:
("research"."notification_attempts"."outcome" = 'SUPPRESSED' AND "research"."notification_attempts"."attempted_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("research"."notification_attempts"."outcome" <> 'SUPPRESSED' AND "research"."notification_attempts"."attempted_at" IS NOT NULL)
